title: Grenada Wins Its First-Ever Olympic Medal: Kirani James's 400m Gold
reason: Confirmed via Olympics.com official news: Kirani James won the men's 400m gold at the London 2012 Olympics on August 6, 2012 in 43.94 seconds, a national record, giving Grenada its first-ever Olympic medal of any color at age 19. This matches the event description's date, athlete, event, time, and significance (first Olympic medal for a nation of ~110,000). No material discrepancies found.

verifications.reason: Multiple independent, authoritative sources (ESPN, Olympics.com) confirm that Kirani James of Grenada won the men's 400m gold medal at the 2012 London Olympics on August 6, 2012, with a time of 43.94 seconds (a national record).
